subject: english
question:
Choose the correct meaning of idiom given below:
"Steal a march on someone"
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3 i.e. Gain an advantage secretly**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__

 
• The idiom **"Steal a march on someone"** means to secretly gain an advantage over someone or to act before someone in order to benefit. (किसी पर गुप्त रूप से बढ़त हासिल करना)

 

 
• **Example:** The company stole a march on its competitors by launching the product a month earlier.

 

 

 
• The word **"secretly"** refers to doing something in a manner that is not publicly disclosed or known. (गुप्त रूप से)

 

 
• **Example:** She secretly planned a surprise party for her friend.

 

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3 i.e. Gain an advantage secretly**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Imitate someone's tactics** (किसी की रणनीति की नकल करना): To copy or replicate someone's methods or strategies.

 

 
• **Example:** The team decided to imitate the tactics of their rivals to win the match.

 

 

 
• **Win by cheating** (धोखा देकर जीतना): To achieve victory in an unfair or dishonest manner.

 

 
• **Example:** He was disqualified from the race because he tried to win by cheating.

 

 

 
• **Announce plans publicly** (योजनाओं को सार्वजनिक रूप से घोषित करना): To make one's intentions or plans known to everyone.

 

 
• **Example:** The company announced its expansion plans publicly during the annual meeting.

 

 

42:Te15,
The correct answer is **Option 1**.
